This 6-month learning path starts with foundational building blocks in Python programming (COU221) and data science concepts (COU4368). The third month covers R programming and machine learning (COU5023) and intermediate-level data science concepts (COU5649). The fifth month covers Power BI data analysis skills (COU6251) and generative AI skills (COU6589). Finally, the sixth month concludes with a data visualization capstone project (COU2260) to emphasize data storytelling and communication. This path allows for gradual increase in complexity and practical application of skills through hands-on projects and real-world applications.

learning_path:
### Learning Path

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU3538 | Human Anatomy and Medical Terminology Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | Establishes foundational knowledge of human anatomy and medical terminology, essential for nursing. |
| 2 | COU6094 | Anatomy: Cardiovascular, Respiratory and Urinary Systems | Coursera | Builds on the previous course by focusing on specific systems, gradually increasing complexity. |
| 3 | COU3339 | Anatomy, Physiology, and Kinesiology for Fitness Professions | Coursera | Expands knowledge to include physiology and kinesiology, further developing systemic understanding. |
| 4 | COU4974 | Anatomy of the Upper and Lower Extremities | Coursera | Increases complexity by focusing on specific regions of the body, reinforcing systemic understanding. |
| 5 | COU2151 | Visualizing the Living Body: Diagnostic Imaging | Coursera | Introduces diagnostic imaging, a critical aspect of nursing practice, and reinforces understanding of human anatomy. |
| 6 | COU2441 | Oncology Nursing（肿瘤护理） | Coursera | Applies systemic understanding to a specific clinical context, oncology nursing, and introduces intermediate-level concepts. |
| 7 | COU4627 | Essentials in Clinical Simulations Across the Health Professions | Coursera | Develops skills in clinical simulations, essential for nursing practice, and reinforces understanding of clinical applications. |
| 8 | COU6091 | Nursing Research: Principles and Methods(护理研究：基本原理与方法) | Coursera | Introduces nursing research principles and methods, essential for evidence-based practice, and reinforces understanding of clinical applications. |

### Path Explanation

This learning path is designed to prepare learners for a nursing program through anatomy and physiology. It starts with foundational knowledge of human anatomy and medical terminology (COU3538), gradually increasing complexity by focusing on specific systems (COU6094) and regions of the body (COU4974). The path then introduces diagnostic imaging (COU2151) and applies systemic understanding to a specific clinical context, oncology nursing (COU2441). The final courses develop skills in clinical simulations (COU4627) and introduce nursing research principles and methods (COU6091), essential for evidence-based practice. This path covers the full duration requested, with at least one course per period, and follows the core educational principles of building on prior knowledge, gradual complexity, systemic approach, clinical relevance, active learning, and paced progression.

| 4 | COU3555 | Global Health Policy | Coursera | Introduces global health policy, connecting to health systems and policy research |
| 5 | COU5755 | Global Health Challenges and Governance Specialization | Coursera | Examines global health challenges and governance, applying to global health policy |
| 6 | COU2968 | Global Health Security, Solidarity and Sustainability through the International Health Regulations | Coursera | Explores global health security, solidarity, and sustainability, applying to global health policy and governance |
| 7 | COU3547 | Global Health Program Equity and Quality: Plan and Manage | Coursera | Focuses on program equity and quality, applying to global health policy and governance |
| 8 | COU5879 | Achieving Health Equity in Healthcare | Coursera | Examines health equity in healthcare, applying to global health policy and governance |
| 9 | COU3773 | Epidemiology: The Basic Science of Public Health | Coursera | Introduces epidemiology, a foundational science for public health and healthcare policy |
| 10 | COU6090 | The People, Power, and Pride of Public Health | Coursera | Explores public health, connecting to epidemiology and healthcare policy |

### Path Explanation

This learning path starts with foundational knowledge of health systems and policy research (COU3818). It then builds on this knowledge with introductory health systems concepts (COU4212) and expands on these concepts to focus on strengthening health systems (COU3437). The path introduces global health policy (COU3555) and examines global health challenges and governance (COU5755). It then explores global health security, solidarity, and sustainability (COU2968) and focuses on program equity and quality (COU3547). The path concludes by examining health equity in healthcare (COU5879) and introduces epidemiology, a foundational science for public health and healthcare policy (COU3773). Finally, it explores public health, connecting to epidemiology and healthcare policy (COU6090).

Note: The available courses do not fully cover the request for a comprehensive learning path on global health systems and healthcare policy. However, this path provides a solid foundation and builds incrementally, starting with foundational concepts and progressing to more advanced topics.

**Learning Path for Confident Public Speaking and Presentation**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX2824 | Public Speaking | edx | Foundational knowledge of public speaking principles, including understanding audience, message, and delivery. |
| 2 | EDX2000 | Making Impactful Presentations | edx | Building on foundational knowledge, this course focuses on designing and delivering impactful presentations, especially when stakes are high. |
| 3 | EDX552 | Introduction to Public Speaking | edx | This course provides a comprehensive introduction to public speaking, covering design and delivery of basic arguments, informative presentations, and complex arguments persuasively. |
| 4 | EDX2232 | Just Be Yourself: The Art of Acting in the Workplace | edx | This course helps learners develop practical application of workplace conversation techniques, including unscripted roundtable discussions and acquiring tools to rally support from teammates. |
| 5 | EDX1300 | Professional Business Presentations | edx | This course focuses on evaluating organizational steps of a presentation, examining various supporting materials, and designing clear and persuasive PowerPoint presentations. |
| 6 | EDX2785 | Business Communications | edx | This course builds on previous knowledge by teaching learners how to build sound and logical arguments, communicate effectively in a business setting, and create various effective and clearly written supporting business documents. |
| 7 | EDX3372 | Communication and Influence in the Digital Age | edx | This course provides learners with a personalized communication guidebook, insights into essential aspects of communication, and frameworks to mitigate various challenges in the digital age. |
| 8 | EDX3422 | The Leader as Coach | edx | This course focuses on developing a coaching mindset, improving interpersonal relationships, and getting the best out of others, which is essential for confident public speaking and presentation. |
| 9 | EDX343 | Public Relations (PR) | edx | This course teaches learners how to build strong public relationships, manage a brand's reputation, and create messages that resonate across channels, which is crucial for effective communication. |
| 10 | EDX413 | Communication Skills and Teamwork | edx | This course provides learners with the skills to determine the most appropriate format for different messages, use top-down thinking to structure communications, and manage conflict in a professional manner. |
| 11 | EDX3370 | Health Economics and Policy | edx | This course focuses on understanding key economic principles governing the healthcare sector, healthcare financing systems, and the complexities of the healthcare labor market, which is essential for confident public speaking and presentation in a healthcare context. |
| 12 | EDX3414 | Beyond Smart Cities: Emerging Design and Technology | edx | This course provides learners with the skills to leverage technological innovation to improve design, planning, and policy of urban living, which is essential for confident public speaking and presentation in a urban planning context. |

This learning path starts with foundational knowledge of public speaking principles (EDX2824) and gradually builds on that knowledge with courses that focus on designing and delivering impactful presentations (EDX2000), introducing public speaking (EDX552), and developing practical application of workplace conversation techniques (EDX2232). The path then focuses on evaluating organizational steps of a presentation (EDX1300), building sound and logical arguments (EDX2785), and creating various effective and clearly written supporting business documents (EDX2785). The final courses provide learners with a personalized communication guidebook (EDX3372), a coaching mindset (EDX3422), and the skills to determine the most appropriate format for different messages (EDX413). The path concludes with courses that focus on understanding key economic principles governing the healthcare sector (EDX3370) and leveraging technological innovation to improve design, planning, and policy of urban living (EDX3414).

I want to learn how to effectively communicate with my audience, handle nervousness, and deliver engaging presentations.

Finally, the last course develops more complex communication skills, including negotiation and conflict resolution, essential for business travel. This path covers the full duration of 16 weeks, with at least one course per period, and provides a solid foundation in Chinese language and culture for business travel.

**Learning Path for English for Professional Communication in a Technical Workplace**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX260 | Upper-Intermediate English: Business and Industry | edx | Develops foundational English language skills, including vocabulary, grammar, and listening and speaking. |
| 2 | EDX2153 | Business Communication | edx | Builds on the foundational language skills by focusing on business communication, including active listening, questioning, and clear communication. |
| 3 | EDX2619 | Business Communications - The Basics | edx | Expands on business communication by covering emotional intelligence, communication models, and effective listening. |
| 4 | EDX2785 | Business Communications | edx | Develops strategic thinking, writing, and interpersonal communication skills, essential for effective business communication. |
| 5 | EDX1300 | Professional Business Presentations | edx | Focuses on presentation skills, including design principles, storytelling, and delivering a polished presentation. |
| 6 | EDX3372 | Communication and Influence in the Digital Age | edx | Develops skills in digital communication, including personal branding, cross-cultural communication, and crisis management. |
| 7 | EDX3082 | English for Doing Business in Asia – Speaking | edx | Prepares learners to communicate effectively in a business context in Asia, including cross-cultural issues, style, and genre. |
| 8 | EDX2106 | English for Doing Business in Asia – Writing | edx | Develops writing skills for business communication in an Asian context, including planning, research, and structure. |
| 9 | EDX2712 | Having Difficult Conversations in the Virtual World | edx | Focuses on effective communication in virtual settings, including active listening, emotion management, and conflict resolution. |
| 10 | EDX3371 | The ABC of Business Communication | edx | Provides a comprehensive overview of business communication, including components, process, and barriers. |

The learning path starts with foundational English language skills (EDX260) and progresses to business communication (EDX2153, EDX2619, EDX2785). The next phase focuses on presentation skills (EDX1300) and digital communication (EDX3372). The path then prepares learners to communicate effectively in a business context in Asia (EDX3082, EDX2106). The final phase develops skills in virtual communication (EDX2712) and provides a comprehensive overview of business communication (EDX3371). This learning path covers the full duration requested, with at least one course per period, and provides a structured progression from foundational to advanced skills.

The course should be suitable for intermediate to advanced learners and last for 6-12 weeks. I want to improve my technical communication skills to effectively collaborate with colleagues and clients.

The advanced courses, including COU1600 and EDX342, cover predictive modeling, effective communication, and deep learning with Python and PyTorch. Finally, the path specializes in deep learning for computer vision with COU1699 and COU3002, and introduces PyTorch and deep learning concepts for decision makers with EDX2929. This learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of cloud computing infrastructure and DevOps deployment. The path continues with practical experience with DevOps tools and methodologies (EDX2010), intermediate-level knowledge of DevOps engineering (COU1857), and understanding of DevOps culture and mindset (EDX2676). The path then covers advanced knowledge of DevOps tools and methodologies (COU3626), understanding of DevOps foundations, principles, and practices (EDX1880), and intermediate-level knowledge of DevOps on AWS (COU625). The path concludes with in-depth knowledge of Google Cloud core services (EDX1712), understanding of cloud operations on AWS (EDX1234), and foundational knowledge of cloud application development (COU4360).

**Learning Path for Confident Public Speaking and Presentation**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX2824 | Public Speaking | edx | Foundational knowledge of public speaking principles, including understanding audience, message, and delivery. |
| 2 | EDX2000 | Making Impactful Presentations | edx | Building on foundational knowledge, this course focuses on designing and delivering impactful presentations, essential for effective communication. |
| 3 | EDX552 | Introduction to Public Speaking | edx | This course provides a comprehensive introduction to public speaking, covering design and delivery of arguments, informative presentations, and complex arguments persuasively. |
| 4 | EDX2232 | Just Be Yourself: The Art of Acting in the Workplace | edx | This course helps learners develop practical application of workplace conversation techniques, essential for confident public speaking and presentation. |
| 5 | EDX413 | Communication Skills and Teamwork | edx | This course focuses on developing effective communication skills, including writing clear and concise professional communications, and designing clear and persuasive PowerPoint presentations. |
| 6 | EDX3443 | Public Relations (PR) | edx | This course provides a comprehensive understanding of public relations, including building strong public relationships, strategic communication plans, and crisis management. |
| 7 | EDX3372 | Communication and Influence in the Digital Age | edx | This course helps learners develop a personalized communication guidebook, essential for effective communication in the digital age. |
| 8 | EDX3277 | Professional Communication: Business Writing and Storytelling | edx | This course focuses on developing practical writing, editing, and data-visualisation skills for creating clear and compelling business communications. |
| 9 | EDX2904 | EmSAT English Preparation - Level 1 | edx | This course provides foundational knowledge of English language skills, essential for effective communication in public speaking and presentation. |
| 10 | EDX1122 | Applied Storytelling | edx | This course helps learners develop practical application insights by leveraging case study interviews, essential for effective storytelling in public speaking and presentation. |

The learning path starts with foundational knowledge of public speaking principles (EDX2824) and gradually builds on this knowledge with courses that focus on designing and delivering impactful presentations (EDX2000), comprehensive introduction to public speaking (EDX552), and practical application of workplace conversation techniques (EDX2232). The path then shifts to developing effective communication skills, including writing clear and concise professional communications (EDX413) and designing clear and persuasive PowerPoint presentations. The final courses provide a comprehensive understanding of public relations (EDX3443) and communication in the digital age (EDX3372), as well as practical writing, editing, and data-visualisation skills (EDX3277). The path concludes with foundational knowledge of English language skills (EDX2904) and practical application insights through case study interviews (EDX1122). This learning path provides a comprehensive and structured approach to becoming a confident public speaker and presenter.

I want to learn how to effectively communicate with my audience, handle nervousness, and deliver engaging presentations.

learning_path:
**Learning Path Table**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX1930 | Linear Algebra, Part 1 | edx | Foundational linear algebra concepts, including vector and matrix operations, and inner products. |
| 2 | EDX2786 | Linear Algebra I: Vectors and Linear Equations | edx | Builds on EDX1930, covering linear equations, vector spaces, and linear transformations. |
| 3 | EDX1319 | Linear Algebra - Foundations to Frontiers | edx | Expands on EDX2786, covering advanced topics like eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and singular value decomposition. |
| 4 | EDX1650 | Introduction to Probability | edx | Introduces probability concepts, including random variables, distributions, and Bayes' theorem. |
| 5 | EDX2692 | Probability - The Science of Uncertainty and Data | edx | Develops probability concepts further, covering random processes, inference methods, and laws of large numbers. |
| 6 | EDX2908 | Math for Machine Learning with Python | edx | Applies linear algebra and probability to machine learning, covering topics like linear regression, neural networks, and Bayesian inference. |
| 7 | EDX3040 | Probability and Statistics II: Random Variables – Great Expectations to Bell Curves | edx | Expands on probability and statistics concepts, covering random variables, expected values, and variance. |
| 8 | EDX3048 | Fundamentals of Statistics | edx | Develops statistical concepts, including estimators, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing. |
| 9 | EDX2080 | Advanced Linear Algebra: Foundations to Frontiers | edx | Covers advanced linear algebra topics, including singular value decomposition, eigenvalue decomposition, and linear least-squares problems. |
| 10 | EDX207 | Machine Learning with Python: from Linear Models to Deep Learning | edx | Applies advanced linear algebra and probability concepts to machine learning, covering topics like neural networks, deep learning, and reinforcement learning. |

**Learning Path Explanation**

This learning path is designed to provide a solid foundation in linear algebra and probability, with a focus on practical applications in machine learning. The path starts with foundational linear algebra concepts in EDX1930 and EDX2786, before expanding to advanced topics in EDX1319. Probability concepts are introduced in EDX1650 and developed further in EDX2692. The path then applies linear algebra and probability to machine learning in EDX2908, before expanding to more advanced statistical concepts in EDX3040 and EDX3048. Finally, the path covers advanced linear algebra topics in EDX2080 and applies these concepts to machine learning in EDX207. This learning path should provide the learner with a comprehensive understanding of linear algebra and probability, sufficient to follow machine learning papers.

| 7 | EDX3384 | Sustainable Finance and Investment | edx | Knowledge of sustainable finance and investment, including ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) considerations. |
| 8 | EDX3131 | Fundamentals of Financial Mathematics and Capital Budgeting | edx | Advanced knowledge of financial mathematics and capital budgeting, including time value of money and risk analysis. |
| 9 | EDX1924 | Machine learning with Python for finance professionals | edx | Practical skills in machine learning and Python programming for finance professionals. |
| 10 | EDX1705 | Yield Curve Analysis | edx | Advanced knowledge of yield curve analysis and its application in finance, including duration and convexity. |

**How the path fits together**

This learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of corporate finance and investment analysis, with a focus on the banking sector. The path starts with foundational knowledge of finance concepts, including money, cash flows, and financial reporting (EDX118). It then builds on this knowledge with industry-specific skills for a career in investment banking and finance (EDX3047). The path continues with in-depth knowledge of finance concepts, including time value of money, capital budgeting, and risk management (EDX2212). Advanced knowledge of financial management, including financial reporting, analysis, and decision-making, is covered in EDX3298. Industry-specific knowledge of credit risk management in banking is introduced in EDX490. The path then explores the impact of fintech on the financial industry, including digital finance and alternative finance (EDX3307). Knowledge of sustainable finance and investment, including ESG considerations, is covered in EDX3384. The path concludes with advanced knowledge of financial mathematics and capital budgeting, including time value of money and risk analysis (EDX3131). Practical skills in machine learning and Python programming for finance professionals are introduced in EDX1924. Finally, advanced knowledge of yield curve analysis and its application in finance, including duration and convexity, is covered in EDX1705.

| 3 | COU4592 | The Art and Science of Economic Policy | Coursera | Emphasis on critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills |
| 4 | EDX3263 | Public Policy Innovations | edX | Integration of real-world examples and case studies |
| 5 | COU3249 | Data Analytics in the Public Sector with R Specialization | Coursera | Development of communication and collaboration skills |
| 6 | EDX3308 | Public Sector Audit and Governance | edX | Pacing that balances breadth and depth |
| 7 | COU5675 | Assisting Public Sector Decision Makers With Policy Analysis | Coursera | Advanced policy analysis techniques |
| 8 | EDX135 | Data for Effective Policy Making | edX | Practical application of data analysis in policy making |
| 9 | COU6457 | Politics and Ethics of Data Analytics in the Public Sector | Coursera | Critical thinking and problem-solving in data-driven policy making |
| 10 | EDX3395 | South African Public Sector Structures, Functions, and Finance | edX | Advanced knowledge of public sector structures and finance |

This learning path starts with foundational knowledge in social sciences and humanities (COU918), followed by a gradual introduction to policy analysis frameworks and tools (EDX3292). The path then emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills (COU4592), and integrates real-world examples and case studies (EDX3263). The learner develops communication and collaboration skills (COU3249) and advanced policy analysis techniques (COU5675). The path concludes with practical application of data analysis in policy making (EDX135) and critical thinking and problem-solving in data-driven policy making (COU6457). The final course (EDX3395) provides advanced knowledge of public sector structures and finance. This learning path covers the full duration requested, with at least one course per period, and follows a sensible order from foundational to advanced.
